text: FTMO is a Czech company with two owners: its co-founders Otakar Šuffner (co-owner and CEO) and Marek Vašíček (co-owner and CTO). Neither owner is a state or state fund.
short: FTMO is co-owned by its Czech founders Šuffner and Vašíček.

source.name: Forbes (Czech edition), republished by FTMO.com – 'Forbes: The FTMO Cover Story'
source.quote: FTMO is also one of the 50 largest taxpayers in the Czech Republic, and its two owners are among the most generous young Czech philanthropists
source.note: The profile names Otakar Šuffner as 'the co-owner and CEO of FTMO' and Marek Vašíček as 'co-owner and CTO' immediately before this passage; they are the two owners referred to.
